entries.9e6daa0c66726987: This is an online chat fortune-telling app that enables fortune readings through real-time communication between fortune tellers and users. Reading fees are charged according to the number of characters, so its feature is that users can consult without worrying about reading time; the company also sells fortune-telling content and provides telephone fortune readings. The number of registered fortune tellers at the end of January 2026 was 1,424, the average monthly number of users for the fiscal year ended December 2025 exceeded 7,300, and the number of readings was 210,000. Revenue is included in the “Other” category of the segment, and no separate amount is disclosed.
